import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health & Lifestyle Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Color palette
palette = sns.color_palette("husl", 8)

# Plot 1: Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by Gender
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='Sleep Duration', y='Quality of Sleep', 
                hue='Gender', style='Gender', s=80, alpha=0.7, ax=ax1, palette=['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4'])
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality by Gender', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(title='Gender', loc='lower right')

# Plot 2: Distribution of Sleep Duration by BMI Category
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
bmi_order = ['Normal', 'Normal Weight', 'Overweight', 'Obese']
existing_bmi = [bmi for bmi in bmi_order if bmi in df['BMI Category'].unique()]
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='BMI Category', y='Sleep Duration', order=existing_bmi,
            palette='Set2', ax=ax2)
ax2.set_xlabel('BMI Category', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_title('Sleep Duration Distribution by BMI Category', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=15)

# Plot 3: Correlation Heatmap of numeric variables
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
numeric_cols = ['Age', 'Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level', 
                'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']
corr_matrix = df[numeric_cols].corr()
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, annot=True, cmap='RdYlBu_r', center=0, 
            fmt='.2f', square=True, ax=ax3, cbar_kws={'shrink': 0.8},
            linewidths=0.5)
ax3.set_title('Correlation Matrix of Health Metrics', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45, ha='right')
ax3.tick_params(axis='y', rotation=0)

# Plot 4: Average Sleep Quality by Occupation
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
occupation_sleep = df.groupby('Occupation')['Quality of Sleep'].mean().sort_values(ascending=True)
colors = sns.color_palette('viridis', len(occupation_sleep))
bars = ax4.barh(occupation_sleep.index, occupation_sleep.values, color=colors)
ax4.set_xlabel('Average Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Occupation', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('Average Sleep Quality by Occupation', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.axvline(x=df['Quality of Sleep'].mean(), color='red', linestyle='--', 
            label=f'Overall Mean: {df["Quality of Sleep"].mean():.1f}', linewidth=2)
ax4.legend(loc='lower right')

# Add value labels on bars
for bar, val in zip(bars, occupation_sleep.values):
    ax4.text(val + 0.05, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2, f'{val:.1f}', 
             va='center', fontsize=9)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
